reviews.title: Wonderful way to organize your team's tasks.
reviews.pros: I loved how easy it was to use. Our team started used it and within a matter of days we all knew our way around Asana without needing any additional training. It's also great how it lets me set up tasks for individuals and track their completion. That ensures that important tasks and milestones are met on time. We also use this to collaborate on projects with other teams and it has worked very well for us with that. Lastly, the drag and drop features are fantastic.
reviews.cons: There isn't much I dislike about Asana. It's worked great for us in the time that we have used it. The only sticking point is the mobile app could be better. Its crashed on me a few times.
reviews.overall: Love it. I would recommend it to people who are looking for a way to organize their tasks and manage projects that are time sensitive. Their pricing is very competitive as well.

reviews.title: Your first step to Project Management
reviews.pros:
1) Quick and easy configurations.

2) User interface is quick and very intuitive which helps to train users quickly on board.

3) Ability to upload files is good one which helps us maintain a small document management system in line.

4) For beginners and small team its very nice as the free plan supports 15 members on the board.
reviews.cons:
1) It can be good for internal team purpose but when you wish to include client it doesn't offers right abstraction so it gets difficult to explain the client about entire project update. The entire update from Asana has to be taken to excel to be sent to client which is bit time consuming.

2) Comments on threads initiate tasks , its email system is bit confusing and unintentional emails are sent repeatedly which needs proper tweaking.

3) The system sometimes tend to get slow may be due to server load .
reviews.overall: Asana is a good tool which we use almost everyday for our sub departments management, for internal teaming nothing can beat it considering its free tier which almost has all the basic and required features. As you grow you need to update and here comes the tricky price , the pricing is bit high as compared to other project management tools in same category.  We can't say we use Asana for everything but asana and Samepage serves our purpose very well.
